description:
Denshattack! is OUT NOW! 🚄💥

Kickflip, grind and drift your way through a vibrant, cel-shaded Japan in this high-speed trick-based action adventure.

Master over 60 handcrafted levels, take on outrageous boss battles, discover hidden collectibles, and chain together huge combos as you become the ultimate rail rider.

Hop aboard and play now on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX Game Pass.

description:
The expedition begins today. The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu is officially out now!

Assemble your crew and descend into a shifting, cursed jungle where your own mind is the ultimate enemy. In this 4-player co-op Lovecraftian horror game, you must hunt for legendary treasures, and survive as madness quietly distorts your reality. With no UI indicators to warn you, you will have to rely entirely on your teammates to know what is real - and what is just a trick of your unraveling mind. Play now on XBOX Series X|S.
